messages:
maya: heads up — we saw a regression on the golden set after rolling quantized q4_8 for model-alpha. correctness dropped from 0.92 -> 0.84 on the curated coding prompts.

sam: ugh. do we know if it's a tokenization diff or a quantization artifact?

maya: initial diff looks like many failures are around short html-snippet inputs, e.g. entities like & < getting normalized differently so model output tokens shift. not typical hallucination errors.

arjun: that makes sense. our fingerprinting/dedupe pipeline normalizes whitespace but doesn't decode HTML entities before hashing, so near-duplicates slipped into both train/holdout and golden.

jen: which means golden might include duplicates of the same source but with different entity encodings — that can amplify apparent regression if eval picks the worse-encoded copy.

sam: i can run a quick cross-eval between fp16 baseline and q4_8. running small job now — will post results.

ops-bot: eval-job-7291 started by sam (est ETA 4m) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: results quick dump:
- fp16 baseline accuracy: 0.923
- q4_8 accuracy: 0.846
- delta: -0.077
- top failure buckets: html-encoding (39%), short-token snippets (21%), exact-match formatting (18%), other (22%)

maya: thanks. so two axes: 1) fix dedupe/normalization so golden/holdout no longer have encoded duplicates, 2) decide if quant profile needs fallback for snippets (disable aggressive integer-only path for inputs < 32 tokens).

arjun: for normalization i sketched a small transformer in the ingest pipeline. snippet: 

```python
# normalization to decode common HTML entities before fingerprinting
import html
def normalize_for_fingerprint(s):
    s = html.unescape(s)
    s = s.replace('\n', ' ').strip()
    return s
```

arjun: will push this as a hotfix to the dedupe stage on staging.

jen: labeler team note — we have ~420 golden candidates flagged as "possible-duplicate-entity-variant". labeler-bot, can you pause auto-assign and migrate those to a relabel queue?

labeler-bot: pausing auto-assign for queue "golden-curation" :pause_button:
labeler-bot: creating queue "golden-html-normalize-relabel" and migrating 420 items. ETA 2h.

maya: schedule:
- today: patch dedupe on staging + re-hash golden/holdout (arjun).
- +2h: run re-eval fp16 vs q4_8 on normalized golden (sam).
- tomorrow: 2-day relabel sprint for the migrated items (jen + labeler pool).
- if delta still > 0.03, rollback q4_8 for model-alpha for short-inputs and open quant ticket.

sam: started normalized eval run. curl we used for reproducibility: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://inference.redwood/api/v1/eval/run -H 'Authorization: Bearer $EVAL_TOKEN' -d '{"model": "model-alpha:q4_8", "dataset":"golden-normalized-v1", "metrics": ["accuracy","exact_match"]}'
```

ops-bot: eval-job-7292 queued (normalized golden).

arjun: pushed dedupe change to staging branch html-entity-fix. tests: local fingerprint collision rate down 0.7% -> 0.02% on sample.

jen: relabel sprint plan posted in #labeling-ops, 3 shifts (AM/PM/EVENING). pinged contractors.

maya: if anyone sees unexpected fallout after dedupe patch (e.g. over-aggressive merging), flag me — we can revert quickly.

sam: normalized eval results in — fp16 0.921, q4_8 0.903, delta -0.018. much smaller.

maya: that's promising. still some tail cases to investigate but looks like majority was dedupe/entity noise.

arjun: will open follow-up PR to add entity-decoding in ingest docs and add explicit unit test for snippet inputs.

jen: relabelers are already 40% through the migrated queue, reporting most items were true duplicates (:+1:).

maya: good work team — leaving this thread open for any further edge-case findings. if relabel shows systematic formatting regressions we'll convene a quick triage. :party_parrot:
